name: Pierre Guilbert
headline: Computer Vision, Machine Learning & Mathematical Modelling
summary: Engineer with 10 years of experience in Computer Vision, Machine Learning, and Mathematical Modelling, with a strong interest in differential geometry and nonlinear optimization.
Passionate about applying advanced mathematics to real-world challenges, I enjoy combining technical expertise and creative problem-solving through collaboration and intellectual exchange.

bullets: Camera modelling and calibration: keypoint detection, bundle adjustment, and optical SLAM.
Human pose estimation: body keypoint detection, triangulation, and trajectory optimization based on physical laws and optical measurements.
Geometric and physical parameter estimation from multi-view images: 3D reconstruction, Gaussian splatting, ball spin, and ball deformation.
Ad-tech: auction price optimization and user click-through prediction.
Software engineering for VeloView: lidar, multi-sensor fusion, and point-cloud processing.
Lidar-based SLAM: design and implementation of a lidar-based SLAM system inspired by the LOAM algorithm.
Contributions to open-source projects: VTK, ParaView, and Ceres Solver.
Research in image and signal processing using the logarithmic image processing (LIP) model.
Neural network training framework using LIP operations.

skills: Physics, PDEs, variational calculus, nonlinear optimization
Multi-view geometry, bundle adjustment, SLAM, pose estimation
Design and training of discriminative and generative models (classification, segmentation, regression, density estimation) with PyTorch
Differential geometry, topology, measure theory, algebra
C++ (Eigen, Ceres, OpenCV, PCL), Python, Git
interests: Exploring morality, ethics, consciousness, and the nature of reality
Long-term stock picking with no intention to outperform the market, but to learn from it
Strength training in bench press, deadlift, and squat
Exploring the state of the art, writing research notes and short mathematical treatises
